These are named within the survey based on the starting configuration of Target A (RP = starts
right, first paired with positive; RN = starts right with negative; LP = starts left with positive;
LN = starts left + negative). Thus, “Q6 RP6” is survey question 6, the sixth block in the RP
permutation.
```{r, include = FALSE}
### Collapse  IAT data down ####
dat$compatible.crit <- combineIATfourblocks(dat$Q4.RP4, dat$Q18.LP4, dat$Q14.RN7, dat$Q28.LN7)
dat$incompatible.crit <- combineIATfourblocks(dat$Q7.RP7, dat$Q21.LP7, dat$Q11.RN4, dat$Q25.LN4)

### Collapse  IAT practice blocks ####
dat$compatible.prac<- combineIATfourblocks(dat$Q3.RP3, dat$Q17.LP3, dat$Q13.RN6, dat$Q27.LN6)
dat$incompatible.prac <- combineIATfourblocks(dat$Q6.RP6, dat$Q20.LP6, dat$Q10.RN3, dat$Q24.LN3)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
### Clean the IAT ### 
clean <- cleanIAT(prac1=dat$compatible.prac, 
                  crit1=dat$compatible.crit, 
                  prac2=dat$incompatible.prac, 
                  crit2=dat$incompatible.crit, 
                  
                  timeout.drop=TRUE, 
                  timeout.ms=10000, 
                  
                  fasttrial.drop=FALSE, 
                  
                  fastprt.drop=TRUE, 
                  fastprt.percent=.10, 
                  fastprt.ms=300, 
                  
                  error.penalty=FALSE)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
### NUMBER OF PARTICIPANTS WHO COMPLETED THE IAT ###
sum(!clean$skipped)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
### TIMEOUT DROP RATE (% of TRIALS) ###
clean$timeout.rate
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
### FAST PARTICIPANT 'BUTTON MASHER' DROP COUNT AND RATE (% of SAMPLE) ###
clean$fastprt.count

clean$fastprt.rate
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
clean$drop.participant
```


```{r, echo = FALSE}
IATreliability(clean)$reliability
IATalpha(clean)$alpha.total
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
data <- cbind(data, clean$D)
data$D <- data$`clean$D`
data$gender <- recode_factor(data$gender, `1` = "Men", `2` = "Women", `3` = "Other")
```


```{r, include = FALSE}
# reverse-score
data$DesireStatus_2 <- 8 - data$RDesireStatus_2
data$DesireStatus_7 <- 8 - data$RDesireStatus_7
data$power.motive_5 <- 8 - data$Rpower.motive_5
data$power.motive_6 <- 8 - data$Rpower.motive_6

# Create Composites
data$Power.comp <- rowMeans(subset(data, select = c("POWER_14", "POWER_15", "POWER_16", "POWER_17", "POWER_18", "POWER_19")), na.rm=TRUE)
data$Status.comp <- rowMeans(subset(data, select = c("STATUS_14","STATUS_15", "STATUS_16", "STATUS_17", "STATUS_18", "STATUS_19")), na.rm=TRUE)
data$DesirePower.comp <- rowMeans(subset(data, select = c("power.motive_1", "power.motive_2", "power.motive_3", "power.motive_4", "power.motive_5", "power.motive_6")), na.rm=TRUE)
data$DesireStatus.comp <- rowMeans(subset(data, select = c("DesireStatus_1", "DesireStatus_2", "DesireStatus_3", "DesireStatus_4", "DesireStatus_5", "DesireStatus_6","DesireStatus_7", "DesireStatus_8")), na.rm=TRUE)
```

Cronbach's alphas for explicit composites
```{r}
psych::alpha(subset(data, select = c("POWER_15", "POWER_16", "POWER_17", "POWER_18", "POWER_19"), na.rm=TRUE))
psych::alpha(subset(data, select = c("STATUS_15", "STATUS_16", "STATUS_17", "STATUS_18", "STATUS_19"), na.rm=TRUE))
psych::alpha(subset(data, select = c("power.motive_1", "power.motive_2", "power.motive_3", "power.motive_4", "power.motive_5", "power.motive_6"), na.rm=TRUE))
psych::alpha(subset(data, select = c("DesireStatus_1", "DesireStatus_2", "DesireStatus_3", "DesireStatus_4", "DesireStatus_5", "DesireStatus_6",
                                            "DesireStatus_7", "DesireStatus_8"), na.rm=TRUE))
```

power analysis
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
m1 <- (lm(D ~ gender, data = data_bin))
effectsize::cohens_f_squared(m1, ci = .95, data = data_bin) # 
pwr.f2.test(u = 1, f2 = 0.24, sig.level = 0.05, power = .8) # 35 sample size

cohens_d(D  ~ 1, data = data_bin, mu = 0)
pwr.t.test(n = 184, d = 0.95, sig.level = 0.05, type = "one.sample")
```

IAT 1
Q1 RP1: Learning Me/Not Me
Q2 RP2: Learning Power/Status
Q3 RP3: Me/Power and Not Me/Status*
Q4 RP4: Me/Power and Not Me/Status*
Q5 RP5: Not Me Me learning
Q6 RP6: Not Me/Power and Me/Status*
Q7 RP7: Not Me/Power and Me/Status*
Q8 RN1: Learning Me/Not Me (11 - 20)
Q9 RN2: Learning Power/Status (1 - 10)


Learning Me/Not Me: Q1.RP1, Q8.RN1, Q15.LP1, Q22.LN1
Learning Power/Status: Q2.RP2, Q9.RN2, Q16.LP2, Q23.LN2

```{r}
setwd("/Users/USERNAME/Downloads") 
datalong <- read.csv("Not Me IAT.csv", header=T)

datalong <- filter(datalong, Finished == 1 & Q32 == 1)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
datalong <- tidyr::gather(datalong, Block, Output, Q1.RP1:Q28.LN7)

# add Pairing Columns based on RP LP RN LN
datalong$Pairing <- 0
datalong$Pairing[datalong$Block == "Q4.RP4" | datalong$Block == "Q18.LP4" | datalong$Block == "Q14.RN7" | datalong$Block == "Q28.LN7"] <- "compatible" 
datalong$Pairing[datalong$Block == "Q7.RP7" | datalong$Block == "Q21.LP7" | datalong$Block == "Q11.RN4" | datalong$Block == "Q25.LN4"] <- "incompatible"

datalong$Section <- 0
datalong$Section[datalong$Block == "Q4.RP4" | datalong$Block == "Q18.LP4" | datalong$Block == "Q14.RN7" | datalong$Block == "Q28.LN7"] <- "Trials" 
datalong$Section[datalong$Block == "Q7.RP7" | datalong$Block == "Q21.LP7" | datalong$Block == "Q11.RN4" | datalong$Block == "Q25.LN4"] <- "Trials"
datalong$Section[datalong$Block == "Q2.RP2" | datalong$Block == "Q9.RN2" | datalong$Block == "Q16.LP2" | datalong$Block == "Q23.LN2"] <- "Learning"
datalong$Section[datalong$Block == "Q1.RP1" | datalong$Block == "Q8.RN1" | datalong$Block == "Q15.LP1" | datalong$Block == "Q22.LN1"] <- "Learning"
datalong$Section[datalong$Block == "Q3.RP3" | datalong$Block == "Q17.LP3" | datalong$Block == "Q13.RN6" | datalong$Block == "Q27.LN6"] <- "Practice"
datalong$Section[datalong$Block == "Q6.RP6" | datalong$Block == "Q20.LP6" | datalong$Block == "Q10.RN3" | datalong$Block == "Q24.LN3"] <- "Practice"


# drop empty output rows? 
# drop rows when pairing = 0?
datalong <- tidyr::separate(datalong, Output, c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8", "V9", "V10", "V11", "V12", "V13", "V14",
                                                "V15", "V16", "V17", "V18", "V19", "V20", "V21", "V22", "V23", "V24", "V25", "V26", "V27",
                                                "V28", "V29", "V30", "V31", "V32", "V33", "V34", "V35", "V36", "V37", "V38", "V39", "V40"))

datalong <- tidyr::gather(datalong, Trial, Output, V1:V40)

datalong <- tidyr::separate(datalong, Output, c("StimuliId", "Time"),sep = "[CX]")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
datalong$Association <- 0
datalong$Association[datalong$Type == "Status" & datalong$Pairing == "compatible"] <- "Me"
datalong$Association[datalong$Type == "Status" & datalong$Pairing == "incompatible"] <- "Not Me"
datalong$Association[datalong$Type == "Power" & datalong$Pairing == "compatible"] <- "Not Me"
datalong$Association[datalong$Type == "Power" & datalong$Pairing == "incompatible"] <- "Me"

datalong$Association[datalong$Type == "Me" & datalong$Pairing == "compatible"] <- "Status"
datalong$Association[datalong$Type == "Me" & datalong$Pairing == "incompatible"] <- "Power"
datalong$Association[datalong$Type == "Not Me" & datalong$Pairing == "compatible"] <- "Power"
datalong$Association[datalong$Type == "Not Me" & datalong$Pairing == "incompatible"] <- "Status"
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
datalong$Time <- as.numeric(datalong$Time)
datalong.num <- datalong
```

```{r}
datalong.num2 <- filter(datalong.num, Type != 0 & Pairing != 0 & Time < 10000 & Time > 300 & Section == "Trials")
datalong.learning <- filter(datalong.num, Type != 0 & Time < 10000 & Time > 300 & Section == "Learning")

# means of reaction time in learning trials
datalong.learning %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Type, Association) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(AvgTime <- mean(Time))

dl.words <- filter(datalong.learning, Type == "Status" | Type == "Power")
t.test(Time ~ Type, data = dl.words) # 

dl.images <- filter(datalong.learning, Type == "Me" | Type == "Not Me")
t.test(Time ~ Type, data = dl.images) # 

# means of reaction time in Me/PS 
datalong.num2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Type, Association) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(AvgTime <- mean(Time))

# means of reaction time in Me/PS BY GENDER
datalong.num2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gender, Type, Association) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(AvgTime <- mean(Time))
```

```{r}
summary(lm(Time ~ Type*Pairing, data = datalong.num2)) # 

data.status <- filter(datalong.num2, Type == "Status")
data.power <- filter(datalong.num2, Type == "Power")
data.NMe <- filter(datalong.num2, Type == "Not Me")
data.Me <- filter(datalong.num2, Type == "Me")

t.test(Time ~ Association, data = data.power)
t.test(Time ~ Association, data = data.NMe)
t.test(Time ~ Association, data = data.Me)
```
